description: Codex: Orks (11e) INSTINCTIVE HUNTERS (Da Big Hunt) at the end of the OPPONENT's Fight phase through the real fight_phase_end window and the strategic_reserves follow-up. Fixture ork11e_orks_reactive (P1 Custodes ACTIVE, P2 Orks), detachment switched to Da Big Hunt (setup privilege, stratagems reloaded). Setup privilege: the Beast Snagga Boyz are repositioned unengaged in the Orks' corner, within 6" of the battlefield edge. The players end the Custodes' Fight phase with the real End Fight Phase button / confirmation dialogs and pass both halves of the Consolidate step; the fight_phase_end window opens for the active Custodes first (nothing to offer) and then for PLAYER 2: the StratagemDialog shows INSTINCTIVE HUNTERS on the Beast Snagga Boyz (enabled Use) while the hot-seat overlay names Player 2. A real click spends P2's CP and the follow-up places the unit in strategic reserves (IN_RESERVES / strategic_reserves, flagged as a repositioned unit so the end-of-round-3 cull spares it); its tokens leave the board. The reserved unit leaves no ghost behind (r3:F1): every model's position is cleared, no P1 unit that could target it before can still target it, and its old spot carries no Objective Control.

steps.comment: setup privilege: Beast Snagga Boyz unengaged in the Orks' corner (within 6" of a battlefield edge)
setup privilege: the owed fights are marked resolved (no attacks) — since #916 END_FIGHT can no longer skip mandatory fights (12.04); this scenario is about the fight_phase_end window, not the fights

steps.script:
var d = tree.current_scene._phase_end_confirm
if d != null and d.visible:
	d.get_ok_button().pressed.emit()
return true

steps.comment: the phase waits for the decision before it ends
on the board before the stratagem

r3:F1 baseline (setup privilege: the Allarus Custodians are moved ~7" from the Beast Snagga Boyz so the targeting check is not vacuous): on the board the Beast Snagga Boyz are a legal target for at least one P1 unit and control a marker on their own spot (P2)

steps.script: ScenarioRunner.event_log_count_containing("INSTINCTIVE HUNTERS: Beast Snagga Boyz is placed in strategic reserves")

var t = ScenarioRunner._find_unit_token("U_BEAST_SNAGGA_BOYZ_A")
return t == null or not t.is_visible_in_tree()
steps.comment: its tokens have left the board
r3:F1: every model has left the battlefield (no position left behind)
r3:F1: no P1 unit that could target them before can target the reserved unit

steps.script:
var spot = Engine.get_meta("ih_ghost_spot", Vector2.ZERO)
return MissionManager._check_objective_control({"id": "ih_probe_obj", "position": spot}, GameState.state.units)
steps.comment: r3:F1: no Objective Control left at their old spot
